request: The contact form on the home page asks for a name, an email and a message, but not a phone number. Add an optional phone field to the form so people can leave a callback number. Keep the form posting to the endpoint configured in src/config.ts, and make the starter's tests pass.

plan.goal: Let visitors leave a phone number on the contact form without changing where the form posts.

scope.title: Optional phone field on the contact form
scope.description: Extend src/components/ContactForm.astro with a labelled phone input (name="phone", type="tel") that is optional, while leaving the form's action bound to CONTACT_ENDPOINT from src/config.ts.

steps.description: Add a label and an input with id="phone", name="phone", type="tel" to src/components/ContactForm.astro, without the required attribute.
Place the new field between the email field and the message field so the form order stays readable.
Build the site and run the test suite to confirm the home page still renders a form posting to the configured endpoint.

out_of_scope.reason: The endpoint is a deployment decision already owned by src/config.ts; the task is to add a field, not to point the form somewhere new.

out_of_scope.item: Client-side validation beyond the browser's built-in input types
out_of_scope.reason: The starter relies on native HTML validation; a custom validation script is a larger change than adding one field.
